title: Birdsey Commercial Named to the  2026 Inc. 5000 List
excerpt: For Birdsey Commercial, the recognition reflects a period of sustained growth achieved without straying from the principles that have long defined the company.

children.text: Recognition reflects sustained three-year growth and Birdsey’s commitment to disciplined execution
— Birdsey Commercial today announced that it has been named to the 2026 Inc. 5000, the annual ranking of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

The Inc. 5000 recognizes independent, privately held U.S. companies based on percentage revenue growth over a three-year period. For the 2026 list, companies were evaluated based on revenue growth from 2022 through 2025.

For Birdsey Commercial, the recognition reflects a period of sustained growth achieved without straying from the principles that have long defined the company. The firm has operated with discipline, strengthened client relationships and held itself accountable along the way.
"Three consecutive years of growth speak to consistency more than momentum,” said

Sandford Birdsey, President/CEO of Birdsey Group. “The Birdsey Standard: Quality, Urgency, Accountability, Resilience and Transparency, shapes how we operate and treat our clients, and it's what keeps us accountable to ourselves. Growth follows when we get those things right, year after year.”

Birdsey Commercial is part of Birdsey Group, a family of specialized commercial real estate companies operating under a shared philosophy known as The Birdsey Standard™. The Standard is built around five operating principles: Quality, Urgency, Accountability, Resilience and Transparency. Together, those principles define how Birdsey earns trust through consistent actions, clear communication and disciplined execution.

The company’s growth comes as Birdsey Commercial continues to expand its capabilities and relationships across the commercial real estate industry while maintaining the service standards its clients depend on.

This year’s Inc. 5000 recognizes companies across industries including technology, manufacturing, healthcare, consumer products and professional services. Collectively, the companies on the 2026 list achieved a median three-year revenue growth rate of 130% and added more than 627,000 jobs to the U.S. economy during the measurement period.

“Every company on the Inc. 5000 has a story of perseverance, smart decision making, and a refusal to sit still,” said Mike Hofman, editor-in-chief of Inc. “Their growth reflects more than strong financial performance. It reflects creativity, resilience, and the customer focus required to build companies that make a lasting impact.”
Inc. will recognize the 2026 honorees at the Inc. 5000 Conference & Gala, October 14–16 in Dallas, Texas.

Birdsey Commercial provides commercial real estate underwriting, asset management, servicing and advisory support to financial institutions and other commercial real estate stakeholders. As part of Birdsey Group, the company operates under The Birdsey Standard™: Quality, Urgency, Accountability, Resilience and Transparency.

Companies on the 2026 Inc. 5000 are ranked according to percentage revenue growth from 2022 to 2025. To qualify, companies must have been founded and generating revenue by March 31, 2022, and must meet Inc.’s requirements for U.S.-based, privately held, for-profit and independent companies.
Inc. is a media brand serving entrepreneurs and business leaders through journalism, resources and recognition programs including the Inc. 5000.
